title: 24 Solar Terms and Miao New Year
prompt: Describe the significance of the 24 solar terms in ancient Chinese agriculture and how the Miao people celebrate their New Year during the Light Snow solar term.
hint: Explain the historical background of the 24 solar terms and detail the customs of the Miao ethnic group during the Light Snow season.
sample: The 24 solar terms were created over 2000 years ago by ancient Chinese scholars to guide agricultural activities. During the Light Snow solar term, the Miao people celebrate their New Year with unique traditions such as wearing silver jewelry, preparing special foods, and gathering for festivals.

title: Traditional Miao Silver Craftsmanship
prompt: Explain the traditional silver craftsmanship of the Miao people and its cultural significance during the New Year celebrations.
hint: Describe the process of making filigree silver jewelry and why silver is important to the Miao culture.
sample: The Miao people create delicate filigree silver jewelry by drawing silver into fine strings and welding them into intricate patterns. Silver symbolizes luck and good fortune and plays a central role in their New Year celebrations.

ja.hint: 銀細工の制作過程と、銀が苗族文化にとってなぜ重要かを述べてください。
ja.sample: 苗族は銀を細い糸状に引き伸ばし、繊細な模様に溶接して美しい銀細工を作ります。銀は幸運や繁栄を象徴し、新年の祝いで重要な役割を果たします。

title: Miao New Year Customs and Festivities
prompt: Describe the customs and festivities of the Miao New Year, including the role of Gumaas and the traditional foods prepared.
hint: Explain the significance of the Gumaas, the silver jewelry worn, and the special foods like sticky rice cakes and smoked bacon.
sample: During the Miao New Year, married daughters called Gumaas return home carrying gifts. Women wear heavy silver jewelry, and families prepare traditional foods such as sticky rice cakes and smoked bacon to celebrate the harvest and new year.

ja.hint: グマアの重要性、身に着ける銀の装飾品、もち米ケーキや燻製ベーコンなどの特別な食べ物について述べてください。
ja.sample: 苗族の新年には、結婚した娘であるグマアが贈り物を持って帰省します。女性は重い銀の装飾品を身に着け、家族は収穫と新年を祝うためにもち米ケーキや燻製ベーコンなどの伝統的な食べ物を用意します。

title: Ancient Chinese Fish Farming in Rice Fields
prompt: Explain the ancient Chinese practice of breeding fish in rice fields and its benefits for agriculture.
hint: Describe how fish help control pests and weeds and enrich the soil in rice paddies.
sample: Ancient Chinese farmers raised fish in rice fields to control pests and weeds naturally. The fish also enriched the soil, maximizing rice production while providing a source of food.
